crew.overview: With his eye on a lovely aristocrat, a gifted illusionist named Eisenheim uses his powers to win her away from her betrothed, a crown prince. But Eisenheim's scheme creates tumult within the monarchy and ignites the suspicion of a dogged inspector.
crew.title: The Illusionist

details.biography: Chris Miller is an American post-production supervisor and producer based in Los Angeles, California. Miller worked as a teacher and counselor in non-profit schools with the LA Unified School District. In 1994, he left his career in teaching to pursue his passion for writing and storytelling. Miller worked as a film screenwriter from 1995 to 1997. In 1997, Miller joined The Digital Difference, where worked as a Post Production Supervisor and Producer, and eventually got promoted to President. In 2001, Miller co-founded the Visionbox Media Group. From 2007 to 2010, he worked for National Geographic Films as Head of Production. In 2011, Miller joined Exclusive Media Group as President of Film Finance Operations and President of Spitfire Pictures. Miller and James Burke are co-founders of the film production and distribution company DisruptiveLA.
details.name: Chris Miller
